description: Build a PDF from PNG and/or JPEG images, one image per page, in the order given. Runs entirely on this machine — the file is read and written locally and never sent anywhere.

force.description: Replace the output file if it already exists

inputs.description: Paths to the images, in page order

pageSize.description: "fit" sizes each page to its image; a4/letter centres it on a fixed page (default: a4)

name: pdf_from_images
title: Images to PDF
